In the full-frame thumbnail the hand endpoint is still visibly on that same crate edge and remains separate from the plants and sleeve.

vo_vg_face_hands_place_readability_3.evidence: At native scale the Ferry Boarding sign, waterfront, railing and open warm ship entrance identify a ferry threshold. embodiment_body_ownership.evidence: The visible head, neck, shoulders, two coat-covered arms, bare hands and two legs belong continuously to the same foreground woman. Neither important hand is fused with the crate or an extra body; the observed acting hand is her right, a laterality mismatch logged separately.

embodiment_joint_chain_and_reach.evidence: The viewer-left acting arm bends from its coat-covered shoulder through the elbow to the wrist at the nearby crate; the opposite arm hangs beside the thigh. Both chains and the short reach are physically coherent. Their side assignment is reversed relative to the authored pose and is recorded in authored-fidelity observations.

embodiment_support_and_balance.evidence: Both boots meet the wet snow-covered ground beneath a stable upright torso with separated feet. The crate bottom sits on the horizontal ledge and the resting hand does not carry its weight. No critical support is hidden or floating.

embodiment_contact_and_space.evidence: The same woman makes the planned hand-to-near-crate-rim contact with coherent fingertip/wood boundaries and ample space beside the torso. The other lowered hand leaves the coat opening clear. The opposite hand performs the contact in the image; this preserves the physical contact mechanism while failing the separate authored laterality check.

embodiment_visibility_and_projection.evidence: The whole saved frame includes face, both wrists, crate/ledge junction, coat opening, knees and boots. The side crate and hanging arm leave the critical garment and contact boundaries assessable; the actor-relative hand swap can be seen directly rather than inferred from an occluded appendage.

scope_note: These eight effective hard gates assess adopted joint readability and physical embodiment. They do not certify all agent-authored wardrobe components or handedness. The independent winter testcase is a separate strict 4/6 fail record, and all authored-fidelity misses are preserved there.
